highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.1 avoids unsafe Vulkan descriptor-pool destruction after allocation failures on Imagination drivers.

bullets.lead: Safer Vulkan out-of-memory handling on Imagination
bullets.detail: Ganesh and Graphite abandon affected descriptor pools after host or device out-of-memory errors rather than destroying them in an unsafe state. Graphite also rejects subsequent allocations through a null pool handle. This driver workaround deliberately trades pool cleanup for safety.
